name: Darapako
source:
In the summer, I came back from the city to live in a house my grandmother had left me.
However, Miko-chan and Ai-chan were living there on their own.
And the two girls, who love me very much, welcomed me back and asked me to have sex with them...
Thus begins a summer of sloppy pakopako!
